description: Like, unlike, follow or unfollow. One target per call. A call that did not go through returns `done: false` with a `reason`. (Requires INSSIST PRO.)

instance.description: Optional. Browser instance id from account_info; defaults to the active one.

instant.description: Optional. Skip INSSIST's action pacing and run now — use only when the user asked for an unspaced or burst action.

postId.description: Target post for "unlike", as returned by a preceding like. Ignored by the other types.

shortcode.description: Alternative target for "unlike": the post shortcode from a permalink (/p/<shortcode>/).

type.description: Exactly one of: "like", "unlike", "follow", "unfollow". No other value is accepted.

username.description: Target account, without @. Required for like, follow and unfollow; ignored by unlike. For "like" INSSIST picks which recent post of that account to like.

name: ig_action
title: Instagram action
